text: sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati . dvīsu bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ #1 yu. khosaddo natthi . bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati katamesu dvīsu tathāgate ca tathāgatasāvake ca imesu kho bhikkhave dvīsu sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti . [383] 137 devame bhikkhave dhammā katame deva sacittavodānañca na ca kiñci loke upādiyati ime kho bhikkhave deva dhammāti . [384] 138 devame bhikkhave dhammā katame deva kodho ca upanāho ca ime kho bhikkhave deva dhammāti . [385] 139 devame bhikkhave dhammā katame deva kodhavinayo ca upanāhavinayo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva dhammāti . āyācanavaggo dutiyo 1 . [386] 140 devamāni bhikkhave dānāni katamāni deva āmisadānañca dhammadānañca imāni kho bhikkhave deva dānāni etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadānanti . [387] 141 devame bhikkhave yāgā katame deva āmisayāgo ca dhammayāgo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva yāgā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ yāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammayāgoti . [388] 142 devame bhikkhave cāgā katame deva āmisacāgo ca dhammacāgo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva cāgā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave #1 yu. davādasamo . imesaṃ dvinnaṃ cāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammacāgoti . [389] 143 devame bhikkhave pariccāgā katame deva āmisapariccāgo ca dhammapariccāgo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva pariccāgā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ pariccāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapariccāgoti . [390] 144 devame bhikkhave bhogā katame deva āmisabhogo ca dhammabhogo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva bhogā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhogānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammabhogoti . [391] 145 devame bhikkhave sambhogā katame deva āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva sambhogā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ sambhogānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasambhogoti . [392] 146 devame bhikkhave saṃvibhāgā katame deva āmisasaṃvibhāgo ca dhammasaṃvibhāgo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva saṃvibhāgā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgoti . [393] 147 devame bhikkhave saṅgahā katame deva āmisasaṅgaho ca dhammasaṅgaho ca ime kho bhikkhave deva saṅgahā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṅgahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṅgahoti . [394] 148 devame bhikkhave anuggahā katame deva āmisānuggaho ca dhammānuggaho ca ime kho bhikkhave deva anuggahā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammānuggahoti . [395] 149 devamā bhikkhave anukampā katamā deva āmisānukampā ca dhammānukampā ca imā kho bhikkhave deva anukampā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ anukampānaṃ
